evidence: Quick Design-only review of specs/spec.md, design/design.md, and design/contract.json. The terminal surface enumeration is otherwise consistent at eight, but the prepare contract describes an additional exports projection and leaves the implementation boundary ambiguous.

findings.issue: The prepare contract says to create all eight surface projections plus the redacted exports projection, while exports_terminal_evidence is already one of the eight surface_ids at line 547 and the edge and quality targets require exactly eight.
findings.why: These copies must agree: as written, an implementer can reasonably produce either eight projections or a ninth exports projection, making the supposedly closed terminal bundle shape and its atomicity tests ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Choose one shape and state it once. Prefer keeping exports_terminal_evidence inside the eight-item surface_ids list and change prepare to say that the eight include the redacted exports projection; make E18 and the 8/8 target derive from that same enumeration.
